jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Background-only artwork for the portrait mobile login screen of Chinese fantasy pixel RPG 远征. Reference image is STYLE, palette and environment only. Create an exceptionally crisp pixel-art complete tall portrait scene, about 9:20 aspect, fully illustrated from top edge to bottom edge. An old dark wooden travel desk in a Chinese frontier inn: warm lantern in upper-left, rolled route maps and bronze compass at side edges, weathered brass and deep dark carved wood, quiet mountains visible only in an old map at upper-right, small red tassels and paper corners near bottom. Keep central 75% of image calm, relatively dark and free of important objects for a parchment login card and title to be drawn by the game. No login panel or user interface is painted into the image. NO WORDS, letters, Chinese characters, logos, watermarks, labels, buttons or input boxes. Rich discrete pixel clusters and hard crisp edges, consistent lighting all the way to all four corners. No blurred filler, no vignette covering missing details, no repetitive mirrored strips, no hard seams. Fully opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for Chinese fantasy pixel RPG 远征. Reference image supplies the exact warrior, horse, armor, red cape and tack identity. Generate ONE coherent animation asset: the red-haired male warrior in black bronze-trim armor SEATED CORRECTLY ON HIS BROWN HORSE, facing straight DOWN toward the camera in elevated top-down RPG perspective. Rider and horse are a single integrated silhouette in every cel, pelvis on saddle, hands on reins, legs occluded correctly, no separate standing rider. Exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows of equally sized SQUARE cells, 24 cels total, aligned regular grid. Every cel contains one COMPLETE rider+horse, consistent scale and camera and centered ground anchor at 50% x,90% y, ample transparent gutters. Entire sheet genuinely transparent. Row 1: 4 unique subtle idle breathing poses. Rows 2-3: chronological 8 distinct walking poses, alternating fore/hind hoof support with body and rider following the gait, natural loop. Rows 4-6: chronological 12 distinct canter/gallop poses including contact, loading, lift, suspension, recovery and opposite support; reins, cape and seated rider follow each phase, seamless loop from cel 12 to cel 1. Full actual anatomy changes; never use a repeated ping-pong loop or mere translation of the same cel. Crisp pixel art designed at 128 logical pixels per cel and enlarged nearest neighbor. Brown horse, dark brown outline, golden harness, black armor, red cape, chestnut hair; upper-left light. NO written labels, numbers, grid lines, frames, scenery, floor, ground shadows, extra limbs, detached body parts, blur or glow. Keep all 24 silhouettes separate and uncropped.
